app.title: ClawDOS – An AI coding agent for DOS
app.description: ClawDOS is a lightweight AI coding assistant designed to run in DOS environments, enabling developers to write and debug code directly from legacy systems.
proposed_tests: Download the ClawDOS executable and run in a DOS emulator
Execute a simple Python script generation task and verify output syntax
Measure response latency for a 100-character prompt
Validate that the assistant can handle multi‑line code completion in a DOS text editor
